text: Drafted the opt-in observation API and engine hooks in HalfFlowCcObservation.scala and HalfFlowCcEngine.scala. Default optimize/legacy calls use no observer. Observed runs record level start/end, each accepted/rejected trial, controller state, frozen trial loss versus rebuilt accepted loss, support/reliability/stabilizer summaries and existing CC variance diagnostics. Requested field/validity snapshots are copied with a run-wide budget; rejected candidate snapshots cannot replace returned state, unavailable candidates and exhausted capture budget are explicit, and observer exceptions propagate. Added six focused tests for output/trace neutrality, cross-level budget, rejected-candidate isolation, observer failure, weight denominators and detached buffers. These Scala tests are NOT YET COMPILED OR RUN: all builds remain deferred until P02 timed reference work completes. The original dirty engine/runner bytes are preserved under local-results/hfq-diagnostics-20261014/pre-instrumentation. Runner integration, declared checkpoint panel, cross-iteration common audit score, real-image trajectory exports and anatomy plots remain to implement. No D01 acceptance gate is passed.
